source.name: OGC Nice — Robinhood, sponsor principal du match, rend hommage à Dante (club article)
source.quote: En tant que partenaire principal et sponsor maillot des équipes premières masculine et féminine, Robinhood continue de soutenir le club dans toutes ses compétitions.
source.note: Club's own article: Robinhood is the club's main partner and shirt sponsor of the men's and women's first teams. The club's partners page lists Robinhood first under 'Partenaires principaux'; Wikipedia's 2026–27 Ligue 1 kit table gives Nice 'Main: Robinhood Markets'.

source.name: OGC Nice — Nos partenaires 2026/2027
source.quote: Robin Hood Kappa Ineos Actual Vbet Limova
source.note: Actual is a Premium partner on the club's partners page (linked to groupeactual.eu). Wikipedia's 2026–27 Ligue 1 kit table places Actual Group on the front of the shirt: 'Nice ... Kappa Robinhood Markets List Front: Actual Group Back: Limova.ai Sleeves: Ineos Shorts: VBET Socks: None'.

source.name: Wikipédia (EN) — 2026–27 Ligue 1, Personnel and kits (Nice row)
source.quote: Kappa Robinhood Markets List Front: Actual Group Back: Limova.ai Sleeves: Ineos Shorts: VBET Socks: None
source.note: Wikipedia's kit table gives Back: Limova.ai. Limova appears as a Premium partner on the club's partners page (logo linked to limova.ai).

source.name: OGC Nice — Nos partenaires 2026/2027
source.quote: Robin Hood Kappa Ineos Actual Vbet Limova
source.note: INEOS is a principal partner on the club's partners page; Wikipedia's 2026–27 Ligue 1 kit table places Ineos on the sleeves.

source.name: OGC Nice — Nos partenaires 2026/2027
source.note: VBET is a Premium partner on the club's partners page (linked to the club's 'Play for fun avec Vbet.fr' article). Wikipedia's 2026–27 Ligue 1 kit table places VBET on the shorts.

source.name: OGC Nice — Nos partenaires 2026/2027 (Kappa listed under Partenaires principaux)
source.note: Kit maker (équipementier): Kappa is one of the three 'Partenaires principaux' on the club's partners page, alongside Robinhood and INEOS; Wikipedia's 2026–27 Ligue 1 kit table gives Kit maker: Kappa.

source.name: Ligue 1 McDonald's / LFP — league title sponsorship (Ligue 1 branded 'Ligue 1 McDonald's')
source.note: League title sponsor whose branding is on the official Ligue 1 McDonald's sleeve patch. Not a direct OGC Nice club deal (deal: ligue-1-mcdonalds-title).

summary: Kappa kit. Robinhood front with Actual; Limova on the back; INEOS, the club's owner, on the sleeve; VBET on the shorts; Ligue 1 McDonald's sleeve patch.
